summary: Phase 149O.16 -- HATP Mandatory Production Consumption Contract Independent Verification: independent-contract-verification-only phase, zero src/pcae/** changes and HMRC-001 itself not amended. Ran the required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.15) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.15 completed/complete/pushed, HMRC-001 v1.0 present and FROZEN-not-VERIFIED, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HMRC-001 (docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_ROLLBACK_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md) directly and completely, and independently, mechanically reconstructed its inventory rather than trusting its own prose: HMRC-REQ-001..085 (85, sequential, gapless, verified by regex extraction and sequence-diff, not by reading the category-index table), MC-1..MC-14 (14, verified by bullet extraction), and the full 45-row attack matrix (verified by row-count and per-row citation check). Independently compared HMRC-001 against all six upstream contracts (HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, RAE-001 v1.0, RWMPC-001 v1.0, PBPA-001 v1.0, PBPC-001 v1.2) for ownership-boundary violations and cross-contract conflicts; found none -- confirmed byte-unchanged by git diff --stat against the phase-entering commit. Read production source directly and independently re-derived every load-bearing factual claim HMRC-001 makes, rather than trusting 149O.15's report: core/hatp_ag_authority.py (confirmed line-172 unconditional simulation_only=True, and confirmed no caller-supplied approval_present/provider/trust-store parameter exists on either gated-authority entry point -- the F-2 closure and MC-5 non-authoritative-caller-bool claims are structural, not merely asserted); core/permission_broker_foundation.py's ExecutionDisabledRule/POL-005 (confirmed unconditional DENY whenever simulation_only=False, confirmed the check is field-driven only with no action_type/execution_class branch -- validating that HMRC-001's generalization of PBPC-REQ-037A, a pcae-push-specific finding, to rollback requests is a valid application of an existing universal rule, not a redefinition); core/hatp_evidence_store.py (HATPEvidenceStore.load, confirmed explicit-ID-only with no latest/glob/single-file-fallback method anywhere on the class); core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (confirmed the exact 13-member closed HATPVerificationStatus vocabulary HMRC-REQ-018 relies on, member-for-member); core/rollback_approval_evidence.py (confirmed the exact three-term fail-closed approval-derivation conjunction and its enclosing fail-closed exception umbrella); core/agent.py's execute_rollback and build_rollback_execution (confirmed both currently treat Wave-7 HATP evaluation as purely additive -- no conditional branch on hatp_authority precedes _run_git_revert or the AG5 write/unlink loop -- and confirmed exactly one production caller exists per function, with no additional un-audited caller anywhere in the repository outside tests/); commands/agent.py and cli.py (confirmed the real, current AG3/AG5 CLI grammar HMRC-REQ-011/012 describe as the future target, and confirmed neither real call site passes hatp_evidence_id today); confirmed no hatp_mandatory_cutover.py module and no Cutover Record exist yet, ruling out premature implementation. Independently reconstructed and verified all 45 attack-matrix scenarios against HMRC-001's own table (not the governing prompt's list), cross-checking each against real source where the underlying mechanism already exists. Verified MC-1..MC-14 individually, including the PREPARED-mode dual-authority trap (HMRC-REQ-034/035/053: identical to LEGACY_COMPATIBLE, no additional AND-condition) and the Cutover-Record-deletion/first-install-distinguishability trap (HMRC-REQ-049/050: a second, independently-monotonic write-once marker required, not mere one-way prose). Searched the full contract text for legacy/fallback/PB/ALLOW/simulation_only/cutover/prepared contradiction patterns; found none. Found zero Blocking defects. Found one non-blocking editorial finding (N-1): HMRC-001's own section 26 requirement-inventory category-index table omits HMRC-REQ-083 through HMRC-REQ-085 from its range listing, even though those three requirements are substantively defined in sections 32-33 and correctly counted in the 85-total inventory -- an index-completeness gap only, no requirement missing or ambiguous. Authored the phase document, docs/PHASE_149O_16_HATP_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md, covering every required section: baseline, contract inventory, cross-contract compatibility, semantic walls/evidence syntax/canonical chain, old-hook disposition and effect-boundary placement, MC-1..MC-14 individual verdicts, cutover state model/storage/monotonicity, legacy disposition and structural preconditions, forbidden caller inputs and threat model, consumption-result no-caching, the full independently-reconstructed 45-attack table, contradiction searches, implementation readiness, findings summary, contract verdict, PY39 sequencing decision, recommended next phase, and explicit confirmations. Authored a new 25-test independent-verification file (tests/test_phase_149o_16_hatp_mandatory_consumption_contract_independent_verification.py, all passing), deliberately not importing constants from 149O.15's own freeze-test module -- every expectation (requirement count, invariant count, attack count, evidence syntax, old-hook additive-only status, MC-14/POL-005 source facts, verification-status vocabulary, approval-derivation conjunction, contract self-consistency, byte-identity of HMRC-001 and all six upstream contracts) is independently re-derived from HMRC-001's text and from direct source inspection. Independently confirmed, via git diff against the phase-entering commit, that no src/pcae/** file was touched and that HMRC-001 itself and all six upstream contracts remain byte-unchanged. VERDICT: HMRC-001 v1.0 VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HMRC-001 v1.0 CONFORMS. Implementation readiness: READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING (implementation itself not begun). B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED, not closed by this phase (contract verification alone cannot close them). HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_16_HATP_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.16.1 -- narrow Python 3.9/3.10 timestamp compatibility repair, before a future 149O.17 implementation-plan phase.
